commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
90+1' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

90' Joao Felix (Barcelona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Unai Simon, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
86' Joao Felix (Barcelona) tries to find Ferran Torres, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
83' Marc Guiu (Barcelona) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.

80' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Joao Felix slips the ball through to Marc Guiu (Barcelona), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
79' Xavi prepares a substitution. Alejandro Balde is replaced by Marcos Alonso (Barcelona).
79' Here comes a substitution. Marc Guiu (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Fermin Lopez.
77' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) replacing Dani Garcia.
77' Nico Williams goes off the pitch and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
75' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

75' Unai Simon makes a brilliant save! Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper! The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
73' Joao Felix (Barcelona) tries to find Fermin Lopez, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
73' Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
69' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta will be replaced by Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao).
67' It will be a substitution. Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is ready to enter the pitch as Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta walks off.
66' Marc-Andre ter Stegen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).

65' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
64' What a big chance! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
60' Xavi has decided to substitute Andreas Christensen and he is replaced by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona).
60' The substitution has been made. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has replaced Oriol Romeu.

58' Joao Felix (Barcelona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Unai Simon, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Unai Simon, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
55' Nico Williams slides a brilliant pass into Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
54' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
54' The resulting corner from Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is cleared by the defence. Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
53' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
53' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
51' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
51' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner.
50' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Ath Bilbao have a corner.
48' Joao Felix (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

47' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Barcelona was in an offside position.

44' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert and denies him with a nice save.
42' The cross into the penalty area from Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
41' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
37' Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
35' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
34' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
32' There's an opportunity for Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

32' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
30' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
27' Joao Felix (Barcelona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
26' Problems for Ernesto Valverde Tejedor as Yuri Berchiche is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) replaces him.
26' It doesn’t look good for Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
25' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
23' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
22' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) will take a corner kick.

21' Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the roof of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
20' Joao Felix (Barcelona) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon is equal to it and makes an easy save.
18' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is flagged for offside.
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gavi (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) sends a long ball forward to Joao Cancelo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

14' Unai Simon pulls off a great save to deny Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
12' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Martinez Munuera who sees an offensive foul.
10' What a chance that is! Joao Felix (Barcelona) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
8' The corner from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
7' An attempted cross from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is cleared.
6' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Marc-Andre ter Stegen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Barcelona are taking a throw-in.

4' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to Ath Bilbao.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Martinez Munuera.
